lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\ApplePhotosConnector\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
12 uses of the private API of the server in 4 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

Nothing in the app calls 7 routes outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).
